name: Coronary angiography sets (CADICA, ARCADE, XCAD, AngioCAD)
what: real fluoroscopy video with the thoracic spine in the background: CADICA 42 patients DICOM at 10 fps, ARCADE 3,000 images, XCAD 1,747 images, AngioCAD 413 patients; heavy contrast, LAO/RAO rotation
status: the only large real thoracic fluoroscopy without a DUA; the thoracic test would be annotated by hand; CADICA (Universidad de Malaga, 42 patients, over 6,000 images), ARCADE (Scientific Data 2024, 3,000 images), XCAD (ICCV 2021, 1,747 images, the link), AngioCAD (413 patients); each set's own licence is read before fetching; CathAction (cathaction, about 500,000 frames, no DUA) is the larger real-fluoroscopy exposure pool found by the sweep of 2026-10-21, with Guide3D (guide3d) beside it
how_to_get: Find each set by name: XCAD at the link; CADICA from the Universidad de Malaga (arXiv:2402.00570); ARCADE from its Scientific Data 2024 article; AngioCAD by name.
Read each licence; fetch to Ceph as a Slurm job where the licence allows research use.
